experiments.hypothesis: Route-specific prerendered metadata and canonical URLs will make non-home pages independently crawlable.

measurement.limitations: Both comparison windows occur after deployment, so this report cannot provide a clean pre-deployment control.

experiments.hypothesis: Query-aligned titles, crawlable links, and focused guide pages will improve discovery and ranking for local safety searches.

measurement.limitations: The before window contains roughly one day after deployment, indexing can lag, and query volumes are small. Treat changes as associated with the release, not proof of causation.

experiments.hypothesis: More accurate recent-report wording, aligned title and H1 text, stronger internal anchors, and corrected canonical alternates will improve qualified CTR without sacrificing average position.

measurement.source: Search Console three-month summary supplied 2026-08-29 and the full query PDF
successCriteria: The Calgary crime-map query cluster gains CTR versus the prior equivalent 28-day period.
Average position is stable or improves; CTR gains caused only by lost impressions do not count as success.
The guide pages gain non-branded impressions and clicks without cannibalizing /map.
